title: Name the tasks
summary: Two goals on the same charts: one has labels to learn from, one does not.

choices.text: Regression for the diagnosis, since the 5,000 coded charts give a numeric target to fit, and classification for the groups.
Supervised classification for the diagnosis, trained on the 5,000 coded charts, and clustering to look for unnamed groups.
Clustering for both goals, because most charts are uncoded and a model trained on 10% of the data cannot be trusted.
Classification for both goals, adding "uncoded" as a fourth diagnosis so the uncoded charts form their own known group.
